{% python %}
import json
import urllib.parse

# Grafana via port-forward on the node (./scripts/port-forward-grafana.sh → :3000).
GRAFANA_BASE = "http://192.168.0.12:3000"

rule = """$exec.rule""".strip()
ns = """$exec.output_fields.k8s.ns.name""".strip()
pod = """$exec.output_fields.k8s.pod.name""".strip()
priority = """$exec.priority""".strip()
falco_output = """$exec.output""".strip()


def grafana_explore_url(pod_name):
    expr = f'{{namespace="falco"}}|="{pod_name}"' if pod_name else '{namespace="falco"}|~"K8sSoar"'
    state = {
        "datasource": "loki",
        "queries": [{
            "refId": "A",
            "expr": expr,
            "queryType": "range",
            "datasource": {"type": "loki", "uid": "loki"},
        }],
        "range": {"from": "now-1h", "to": "now"},
    }
    return GRAFANA_BASE + "/explore?orgId=1&left=" + urllib.parse.quote(json.dumps(state), safe="")


def grafana_dashboard_url():
    return GRAFANA_BASE + "/d/k8s-soar-findings/k8s-soar-falco-findings?from=now-1h&to=now"


explore_url = grafana_explore_url(pod)
dashboard_url = grafana_dashboard_url()

THREATS = {
    "K8sSoar Shell In Victim Container": {
        "scenario": "01",
        "name": "Shell in victim container",
        "mitre_id": "T1059",
        "mitre_technique": "Command and Script Interpreter",
        "mitre_tactic": "Execution",
        "attack_vector": "Post-exploitation: adversary spawns an interactive shell (bash/sh) inside a running container to execute commands, explore the filesystem, and stage follow-on actions.",
        "threat_model": "STRIDE — Tampering (arbitrary process execution), Information Disclosure (filesystem and env enumeration). Kill-chain position: Execution after initial container foothold.",
        "preventive": "Kyverno require-non-root (audit)",
        "detective": "Falco: spawned_process + shell binary in workload namespace",
        "enforce": "—",
        "soar_response": "Notify (Jira + Slack); no automatic quarantine on this rule",
    },
    "K8sSoar Sensitive Credential Access": {
        "scenario": "03",
        "name": "Service account token / credential read",
        "mitre_id": "T1552.007",
        "mitre_technique": "Unsecured Credentials: Container API",
        "mitre_tactic": "Credential Access",
        "attack_vector": "In-cluster adversary reads the mounted Kubernetes service account JWT from /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token to authenticate to the API server and enable lateral movement or privilege escalation.",
        "threat_model": "STRIDE — Information Disclosure (credential theft), Elevation of Privilege (API access via stolen token). Kill-chain: Credential Access → Lateral Movement staging.",
        "preventive": "Kyverno restrict-sa-automount (audit)",
        "detective": "Falco: open_read on serviceaccount token path",
        "enforce": "—",
        "soar_response": "Quarantine pod (security.quarantine=true → Cilium network isolation)",
    },
    "K8sSoar Reverse Shell Outbound": {
        "scenario": "04",
        "name": "Reverse shell outbound",
        "mitre_id": "T1059.004",
        "mitre_technique": "Command and Script Interpreter: Unix Shell",
        "mitre_tactic": "Execution",
        "attack_vector": "Compromised container uses shell built-ins to open an outbound TCP connection (/dev/tcp), consistent with reverse-shell staging or C2 callback to an external listener.",
        "threat_model": "STRIDE — Tampering (command execution), Information Disclosure (exfil channel). ATT&CK: Execution → Command and Control. Tetragon records tcp_connect on labeled pods.",
        "preventive": "—",
        "detective": "Falco: shell process + outbound connection; Tetragon TracingPolicy k8s-soar-detect-reverse-shell",
        "enforce": "Tetragon tcp_connect observability; Cilium quarantine CNP on label",
        "soar_response": "Quarantine pod (network isolation)",
    },
    "K8sSoar Crypto Miner Process": {
        "scenario": "05",
        "name": "Crypto miner process",
        "mitre_id": "T1496",
        "mitre_technique": "Resource Hijacking",
        "mitre_tactic": "Impact",
        "attack_vector": "Adversary runs a process matching known cryptocurrency miner names (xmrig, minerd, cpuminer, ethminer) inside a container to hijack CPU for unauthorized mining.",
        "threat_model": "STRIDE — Denial of Service (CPU exhaustion), Impact (resource hijacking). Common post-compromise monetization path on exposed workloads.",
        "preventive": "Kyverno disallow-latest-tag (audit)",
        "detective": "Falco: spawned_process where proc.name matches miner signatures",
        "enforce": "Cilium quarantine network policy",
        "soar_response": "Delete compromised pod",
    },
}

DEFAULT = {
    "scenario": "—",
    "name": rule or "Unknown Falco rule",
    "mitre_id": "—",
    "mitre_technique": "See MITRE ATT&CK Containers matrix",
    "mitre_tactic": "—",
    "attack_vector": "Unmapped k8s-soar rule. Review Falco output and threat-matrix.md.",
    "threat_model": "Map scenario to STRIDE and MITRE ATT&CK (Containers) during triage.",
    "preventive": "—",
    "detective": f"Falco rule: {rule}",
    "enforce": "—",
    "soar_response": "See Master Responder routing",
}

t = THREATS.get(rule, DEFAULT)


def text_node(text, marks=None):
    node = {"type": "text", "text": str(text)}
    if marks:
        node["marks"] = marks
    return node


def paragraph(*nodes):
    return {"type": "paragraph", "content": list(nodes)}


def heading(level, title):
    return {
        "type": "heading",
        "attrs": {"level": level},
        "content": [text_node(title)],
    }


def bullet_list(items):
    return {
        "type": "bulletList",
        "content": [
            {
                "type": "listItem",
                "content": [paragraph(text_node(item))],
            }
            for item in items
        ],
    }


mitre_href = (
    f"https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/{t['mitre_id'].replace('.', '/')}/"
    if t["mitre_id"].startswith("T")
    else "https://attack.mitre.org/matrices/enterprise/containers/"
)

content = [
    heading(2, "Incident summary"),
    paragraph(
        text_node("Falco detected a runtime threat in the k8s-soar security lab."),
    ),
    bullet_list([
        f"Rule: {rule}",
        f"Priority: {priority or '—'}",
        f"Namespace: {ns}",
        f"Pod: {pod}",
        f"Scenario ID: {t['scenario']} — {t['name']}",
        f"Falco output: {falco_output or '—'}",
    ]),
    heading(2, "Attack vector"),
    paragraph(text_node(t["attack_vector"])),
    heading(2, "Threat modeling"),
    paragraph(text_node(t["threat_model"])),
    heading(2, "MITRE ATT&CK (Containers)"),
    bullet_list([
        f"Tactic: {t['mitre_tactic']}",
        f"Technique: {t['mitre_id']} — {t['mitre_technique']}",
        f"Reference: {mitre_href}",
        "Matrix: https://attack.mitre.org/matrices/enterprise/containers/",
    ]),
    paragraph(
        text_node(f"{t['mitre_id']} — {t['mitre_technique']}", [
            {"type": "link", "attrs": {"href": mitre_href}},
        ]),
    ),
    heading(2, "Defensive controls (k8s-soar)"),
    bullet_list([
        f"Prevent (Kyverno): {t['preventive']}",
        f"Detect (Falco): {t['detective']}",
        f"Enforce / observe (Tetragon / Cilium): {t['enforce']}",
        f"SOAR response: {t['soar_response']}",
    ]),
    heading(2, "Forensic logs (Grafana)"),
    paragraph(
        text_node("Full Loki history is in Grafana — use the links below (not pasted inline)."),
    ),
    paragraph(
        text_node(
            f"Open Loki Explore — filter: {{namespace=\"falco\"}}|=\"{pod or 'K8sSoar'}\"",
            [{"type": "link", "attrs": {"href": explore_url}}],
        ),
    ),
    paragraph(
        text_node("k8s-soar — Falco Findings dashboard", [
            {"type": "link", "attrs": {"href": dashboard_url}},
        ]),
    ),
]

body = {
    "fields": {
        "project": {"key": "KAN"},
        "summary": f"SOAR Alert: {rule} — {ns}/{pod}",
        "description": {"type": "doc", "version": 1, "content": content},
        "issuetype": {"name": "Task"},
    }
}

print(json.dumps(body))
{% endpython %}
